adaptation_notes: Official compiled trainer (dnngp.cpython-39 .so) called directly with protocol splits; the official internal KFold(shuffle, random_state=SEED) path is bypassed.

Official network captured from the compiled trainer at runtime; three Conv1D(64, k=4, swish, L2) blocks, Dense(3), dropout 0.3, Dense(1); Adadelta; CCC loss; ReduceLROnPlateau(factor 0.8, min_delta 1e-4, min_lr 1e-6) and EarlyStopping(val_loss, restore_best_weights).
Input PCA at 95% variance is refitted on each inner/dev training subset (upstream example uses a whole-dataset pc95 matrix from plink2); raw markers not used directly.
Targets are the released wheat.Y standardized yields used as-is (upstream paper predicts preprocessed EBVs; no EBV step here).
The compiled prepare() hardcodes tf.random.set_seed(123)/PYTHONHASHSEED; protocol seeds are applied immediately before each fit and to numpy shuffle order.
Inner best epoch is argmin of per-epoch val_loss matching EarlyStopping(restore_best_weights); refit replays the frozen per-epoch median lr for the median epoch count on merged dev rows.
